title: Miras's modpack for phones
description: Optimization and QoL mods for a smooth Minecraft Java experience on phones via MoJo & other launchers.
body:
## Why do you need this modpack?

**MMFP (Miras's Modpack for Phones)** is a Fabric modpack designed specifically for Android devices. Its goal is to provide the best possible Minecraft Java experience on smartphones by combining carefully selected performance mods, optimized default settings, and useful quality-of-life improvements.

Every included mod has been tested with mobile hardware in mind to keep the pack lightweight, stable, and responsive.

> Looking for the lightest possible experience? Try MMFP Lite - maximum performance with the smallest possible footprint. You can download it from the "Versions" section.

---

## 🚀 Performance First

MMFP comes with pre-configured graphics settings and optimized mod configurations designed specifically for mobile devices.

<details>
<summary>Performance improvements include:</summary>

- Reduced memory usage.
- Optimized rendering.
- Faster chunk loading.
- Lower CPU/GPU load.
- Better frame pacing on smartphones.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Core optimization mods:</summary>

- **Sodium**
- **Lithium**
- **ModernFix**
- **FerriteCore**
- **ImmediatelyFast**
- **EntityCulling**
- **More Culling**
and other carefully selected optimization mods.

</details>



> Tested on Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra: from 74 FPS vanilla → 120 FPS (display cap) with MMFP.

---

## 🛠️ Quality of Life

MMFP also includes lightweight QoL features that improve everyday gameplay without significantly affecting performance.

<details>
<summary>Features:</summary>

- **Mod Menu** (a mod menu to view the list of mods you have installed).
- **AppleSkin** (hunger HUD info). 
- **Xaero's World Map** (map & navigation optimized for mobile). 
- **ZoomX** (zoom).
- **LambDynamicLights** (dynamic handheld lighting optimized for mobile).
- **Iris** (a modern shader pack loader).
- **Language Reload** (reduces load times and adds fallbacks for languages).

</details>

---

## 🎨 Additional Features

The following features are included but **disabled by default** for maximum performance.
<details>
<summary>Pre-configured shaders for maximum FPS on smartphones:</summary>

- **MakeUp - Ultra Fast:** lightweight shader focused on maximum 
performance with minimal visual impact.
- **Complementary Reimagined:** balanced shader with good visuals 
while remaining relatively lightweight.
- **Sildur's Vibrant Lite:** lite version of Vibrant shaders, 
optimized for low-end hardware.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Built-in Resource Packs: </summary>

- **Continuity** (connected textures).
- **Low On Fire** (cleaner screen when burning).
- **Default Dark Mode** (eye-friendly dark interfaces).

</details>

---

## ⚡ MMFP vs MMFP Lite

| Feature | MMFP | MMFP Lite |
| :--- | :---: | :---: |
| **Performance Mods** | ✅ | ✅ |
| **Optimized Configs** | ✅ | ✅ |
| **QoL Mods** | ✅ | ❌ |
| **Shader Support** | ✅ | ❌ |
| **Resource Packs** | ✅ | SodiumTranslations only |
| **Minimal Download Size** | ❌ | ✅ |

**MMFP** — Best balance between performance and features.

**MMFP Lite** — Maximum performance with the smallest possible footprint.

---

## 📲 Installation

Since the modpack is fully optimized for phones, you can download it directly from within the launcher app without downloading any third-party files:

1. Open your launcher on your phone.
2. Click the "Create Instance" button.
3. Scroll down to the "Download a Modpack" section.
4. In the search bar, enter the name of this modpack: `Miras's ModPack for phones`.
5. Click the "Install / Download" button. The launcher will automatically configure the correct Fabric version, download all optimizations, and prepare the game for launch!

---

## 💾 Alternative installation method (for other launchers / manually)

1. Download the latest version of the .mrpack file from this Modrinth page.
2. In your launcher, select "Import .mrpack" and select the downloaded file.

⚠️ **Important:** Do not unzip the .mrpack file like a regular ZIP archive; launchers must read it in its entirety.

---

## 💡 RAM Allocation Recommendations

Allocating the wrong amount of memory will cause the game to crash. Follow these guidelines based on your version:

* **MMFP:** 4 GB minimum, **4 GB or more recommended**.
* **MMFP Lite:** 2 GB minimum, **4 GB recommended**.

⚠️ **Important:** Never allocate your smartphone's entire RAM! Always leave at least 2-3 GB free for the Android OS, otherwise the system will force-close your launcher.
